description: Checks one public host's SSL certificate, the free SSL certificate checker: one TLS handshake on port 443 with the name sent as SNI and nothing sent but the handshake. Whether the certificate is valid for the name, who issued it, valid from and until with the days left (a warning under 30, a failure once expired or before it starts), the names it covers, its key and signature, the chain as sent and whether it verifies to a root Node.js trusts, the TLS version and cipher agreed, and whether TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are still accepted. Then one request each to http:// for whether it moves to https://, and to https:// for HSTS. Each finding has its state in a word and, when something is wrong, what to do. Public addresses only.

host.description: The host to check, such as example.com or www.example.com. A full address is taken too, and only its host is used.

name: mttr_ssl_check
title: Check a certificate
